title: Annual Sports Day 2026
content: Annual Sports Day will be held on August 15, 2026. All students are requested to participate actively in various sports events.

title: First Terminal Examination Schedule
content: First Terminal Examination will start from August 20, 2026. Students should prepare accordingly and check the detailed schedule on the notice board.

title: Independence Day Celebration
content: School will remain closed on August 15, 2026 for Independence Day. Cultural programs will be organized on August 14.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting
content: Parent-Teacher Meeting is scheduled for August 18, 2026. All guardians are requested to attend and discuss their child's progress.
